title: Messages
emptyStudent: Each conversation is about one of your applications: open it from "My applications" to write to the company.
emptyEmployer: Each conversation is about an application: open it from the applicants of your offers to write to a student.
notFound: This conversation does not exist or is not yours.
closed: This conversation is closed because the application was withdrawn or the offer was removed. You can still read it.
hint: Enter sends the message; Shift+Enter starts a new line.
